name: The Nest
description: Broken shells and cracked stone form a crude nest. The air vibrates with angry clicks, and something larger shifts in the dark.
creature_presence: Reef crabs guard the nest; a larger brute lurks among the shells.

interactables.name: nest debris
interactables.examine_text: Shell fragments, kelp strands, and bits of drift. Something glints within.

take.empty_text: You've already taken what was worth taking.
